coverage: active release, rollback anchor, and recent high-risk evaluation methods
source_of_truth: docs/excluded_approaches.md plus the linked release manifests

experiments.dataset_scope: official report, 100 items; not comparable to historical 112-item table
experiments.summary: Primary -> Challenger -> Targeted Repair -> Fresh Review; official report is archived, but no promotion is inferred across dataset scopes.
experiments.restart_rule: Run the official evaluation before drawing a capability conclusion; roll back on the protocol gates.

experiments.summary: Published GRH v1.1 / ARM v2.1.3 OFF release used as the current rollback anchor.
experiments.restart_rule: Use only as a comparison or rollback target; do not call its local 119 result an official hidden-set score.

experiments.summary: Third invalid-rescue round produced correct damage in strict replay and was archived.
experiments.restart_rule: Do not replay the same protocol; a restart needs a new hypothesis, method id, and preregistration.

experiments.summary: EACL host replay and architecture audit; no capability promotion evidence.
experiments.restart_rule: Keep the host-only audit separate from model capability experiments.

experiments.summary: Team-built 112-item smoke run; not an official evaluation and not a hidden-set result.
experiments.restart_rule: Use only for local diagnostics; preserve official/proxy scope separation.

experiments.dataset_scope: thinking-on local replay and health probes
experiments.summary: Thinking-on adaptive candidate-first specification; independent ability promotion was not established.
experiments.restart_rule: Do not enable by copying the spec; create a new preregistered experiment if evidence changes.

experiments.dataset_scope: official-like hard20, eval-112, and public regression; 50 paired records
experiments.summary: Ten-round paired replay completed with zero bounded-tail activations; candidate and baseline both scored 7 correct, 9 incorrect, 9 invalid.
experiments.restart_rule: Do not infer capability failure or benefit from this unactivated window; run the separately preregistered length-pressure activation probe before any new real-endpoint window.

experiments.dataset_scope: complex, medium, and official-like hard subsets; 50 paired records
experiments.summary: Independent answer formation triggered once; candidate 20/4/1 versus baseline 19/5/1, with no invalid reduction.
experiments.restart_rule: Keep default-off. A restart requires a materially different missing-candidate formation hypothesis, a clean paired window, and a new preregistration.

experiments.dataset_scope: fresh 25-item set; 50 paired records across 10 rounds
experiments.summary: Incumbent-only structured Challenger activated 17/25 times; candidate and baseline both scored 24/0/1 with equal 1.68 average calls and no truncation.
experiments.restart_rule: Keep default-off. A restart requires a different confirmation hypothesis, a new fresh set, and a new paired preregistration; do not treat this no-gain window as a capability verdict.

experiments.dataset_scope: external OlymMATH, AIME, and HLE Math pools; 50 paired records
experiments.summary: First X01-X10 run was voided because SymPy was not preflighted and candidate/baseline second-call budgets differed; its numbers are not evidence.
experiments.restart_rule: Do not reuse this run. The corrected protocol uses method ARM-V2.1.8-EXTERNAL-LENGTH-PRESSURE-002-20261005 with dependency preflight and equalized budgets.

experiments.dataset_scope: external OlymMATH, AIME, and HLE Math pools; 50 paired records
experiments.summary: Corrected window activated 3/25 candidate records; candidate scored 5/15/5 versus baseline 3/17/5, with zero versus three truncation events and equal 2.00 average calls.
experiments.restart_rule: Keep default-off. Run a new independent paired replication before any promotion; preserve the no-correct-to-incorrect gate, equalized budgets, dependency preflight, and multi-pool scope.

experiments.dataset_scope: independent external OlymMATH, AIME, and HLE Math pools; 50 paired records disjoint from X window
experiments.summary: Independent Y01-Y10 replication activated finalizer 3/25; candidate and baseline both scored 3/15/7 with equal 2.00 average calls, candidate truncations 0 versus 2, and one correct-to-incorrect transition.
experiments.restart_rule: Keep default-off. Do not promote from this replication; any restart requires a materially different truncation hypothesis, a fresh disjoint paired preregistration, and the no-correct-to-incorrect gate.

experiments.dataset_scope: independent external OlymMATH, AIME, and HLE Math pools; 50 paired records disjoint from X/Y windows
experiments.summary: Guard activated 25/25 and kept the original CFR Challenger for complete incumbents; candidate scored 6/15/4 versus baseline 2/17/6, but one correct-to-incorrect transition failed the safety gate.
experiments.restart_rule: Keep default-off. Do not promote from this window; any restart requires a new disjoint paired window and a materially different incumbent-preservation hypothesis.

experiments.dataset_scope: new external OlymMATH, AIME, and HLE Math pools; 25 paired records across Q01-Q10
experiments.summary: Answer-commit-first completed with candidate 0/15/10 versus baseline 1/15/9; truncations fell 3 to 0, but one correct-to-incorrect transition and one incorrect-to-invalid transition failed the safety and exploration gates.
experiments.restart_rule: Keep default-off. Do not promote from this window; any restart requires a materially different first-call formation hypothesis, a new disjoint paired preregistration, and the no-correct-to-incorrect gate.

experiments.dataset_scope: new external OlymMATH, AIME, and HLE Math pools; T01-T10 preregistered paired window
experiments.summary: T01-T10 completed with candidate 4/15/6 versus baseline 3/16/6; continuation activated 0/25, invalid did not decrease, and the candidate truncation count was one higher, so the result is not attributable to v2.3.
experiments.restart_rule: Keep default-off. Do not infer capability from this unactivated window; any restart requires an activation-focused, disjoint paired preregistration with a minimum activation gate and the no-regression safety gate.
